title: F169.3 the brand's parts: the overview
caption: Three picks put the mark on Orbi and above the Overview's first words, draw the name's ball at one size, and give the footer its links.

cards.title: F169.3 The brand's parts
cards.text: The mark is the only ball on the site, the name's ball is 0.41 of its letters wherever the name stands, and the footer leads somewhere.

cards.title: Orbi wears the mark
cards.text: On its button in the header, 20 across, in its panel's head, 22, and on a phone's button, 28, beside the words Ask Orbi. Steps 3 and 4.

cards.title: The mark opens the page
cards.text: It stands above the Overview's first words, 64 across and 48 on a phone. How the section takes it is the first card's pick. Step 7.

cards.title: The name's ball, one size
cards.text: The ball takes its size from the name's own letters, and flat says 0.41. Glass and the picture's ball each wait for a card. Steps 2, 6 and 8.

cards.title: The footer, one row
cards.text: The name and the header's line on the left, GitHub, Licence and louis-agent.dev on the right. Where Licence leads is the second card's pick. Steps 5 and 9.
